company.name: Materialize
company.shortDescription: Materialize is a streaming SQL database company that simplifies the application development for developers.
company.description:
Materialize is a streaming SQL database company that makes it easy for developers to understand streaming data, answer complex questions, and build intelligent applications using standard technology. Materialize allows users to ask questions about their data, and then get low-latency results even as the underlying data changes and keeps the results of the queries and incrementally updates them as new data comes in.

The company was founded in 2019 and is headquartered in New York.
